colors-cream-a16.comment: cream at 16% — the dark-mode counterpart to ink.a12

colors-ink-600.comment: canonical Ink — warm near-black, text and borders

colors-ink-a86.comment: ink 900 at 86% — the modal / lightbox scrim (deeper base than the a12/a18/a24 borders)

colors-graphite-400.comment: card — the lightest dark surface, so it sets the contrast floor for everything that sits on dark. Held here because it is the lightest value at which red.200, chalk.400 and green.400 all still clear AA; a step lighter and the brand red has no usable value left.

colors-graphite-800.comment: page background baseline — the content ground. Not black: black sits below it as `backdrop`, which is what gives that role its meaning back.

colors-graphite-900.comment: backdrop — the recessed mat below page, and now genuinely below it. True black.

colors-graphite-a16.comment: chalk at 16% — subtle border on graphite

colors-chalk-100.comment: primary text and borders on graphite

colors-chalk-400.comment: muted text on graphite — clears AA on `card`, the lightest of them (5.16:1). Tied to how light `card` is: it had to go this pale once the surfaces came up.

colors-red-200.comment: confetti brand Red, lifted furthest — the palest step, and the ONLY one that reads AS TEXT on every dark surface including `card` (4.96:1). This is also the ceiling that fixes how light `card` can go: there is nothing paler to fall back on.

colors-red-300.comment: confetti brand Red, lifted — reads on the darker surfaces but not on card (3.50:1). Only usable as the dark accent when `card` is close to black, which it no longer is.

colors-red-600.comment: deepened Red — kept as the danger family's dark step. No longer the hazard stripe: that pair moved to yellow/black (see the yellow family below).

colors-yellow-500.comment: hazard yellow on a light page — carries black at 12.88:1, and the black stripes read as stripes rather than texture

colors-yellow-600.comment: the deeper step, for DARK mode where the 500 glares against a near-black page. Still carries black at 9.93:1.

colors-green-100.comment: pale tint — the subtle end of the pair in LIGHT mode, carrying green.700 (5.25:1)

colors-green-400.comment: success AS TEXT on a dark surface — lifted enough to clear AA on card, the lightest dark surface (5.5:1)

colors-green-600.comment: the rich green — success as a FILL, carrying a white label (5.34:1). Same in both modes; a fill does not need to move.

colors-green-700.comment: success AS TEXT on a light surface (4.86:1 on cream)

colors-green-800.comment: deep tint — the subtle end of the pair in DARK mode, carrying chalk (10.37:1)

colors-pine-300.comment: brand, lifted enough to read AS TEXT on the forest dark surface

colors-pine-500.comment: Adventure brand green — reads as text on sand (4.8:1) and as button fill w/ white (6.6:1)

colors-sand-a12.comment: bark at 12% — subtle border on sand

colors-bark-600.comment: warm near-black — Adventure light-mode text and borders

colors-forest-a16.comment: sand at 16% — subtle border on forest

colors-neon-pink-600.comment: deep magenta — brand AS TEXT on light

colors-grape-900.comment: neon light text / border — deep purple

colors-glow-100.comment: neon dark text / border — light lavender

colors-stone-400.comment: recessed mat — a step below page

colors-stone-600.comment: muted text — 5.05:1 on page, 5.28:1 on raised, 4.66:1 on panel

font-size-400.comment: utility step — off the 4px grid (like 14), for body-large / small subheads

font-size-600.comment: utility step — off the 4px grid, sits between h5 (20) and h4 (24)

font-size-hero.comment: container-query driven headline, above the fixed ramp

shadow-hard-ink.comment: hard offset shadow — the sticker lift, no blur

shadow-hard-cream.comment: dark-mode counterpart — light offset against dark surfaces

shadow-soft.comment: diffuse ambient shadow on light surfaces — rests just above the page

shadow-lifted.comment: soft, deeper — hover and floating surfaces on light

shadow-soft-deep.comment: dark-surface counterpart of soft — black, since a light shadow does not read on dark

effect-brightness-lighten-strong.comment: 22% brighter — the bump a theme needs when brightness is carrying the whole hover, with no lift to help. 1.1 reads on a pale fill and all but vanishes on a deep one, which is what left Adventure's pine buttons looking inert.

effect-brightness-rest.comment: 1 — no lightness change, the pressed counterpart to a theme's hover brightness

effect-button-hover-brightness.comment: hover lightness multiplier for buttons that change lightness instead of lifting

motion-tilt-subtle.comment: outer bound of the hand-placed sticker tilt — components scale this by a per-instance multiplier in -1..1

motion-tilt-none.comment: no tilt — cards stay square on hover

motion-tilt-max.comment: outer bound of the hand-placed sticker angle

motion-lift-soft.comment: a quiet rise with no sideways travel — the premium counterpart of lift

motion-transform-lift.comment: how far an interactive surface rises on hover

motion-duration-ambient.comment: one loop of a continuous, non-reactive animation — a texture that drifts rather than a state that changes

motion-easing-ambient.comment: constant speed, so a looping animation has no perceptible seam

motion-button-lift.comment: the hover transform on filled buttons — a lift, or rest (no move), per theme

duration-300.comment: one loop of a continuous ambient motion — slow enough to read as texture moving, not as a control reacting

easing-linear.comment: the only correct curve for a seamless loop — any easing makes a continuous animation pulse at the seam

size-switch-thumb.comment: 20px — leaves a 2px inset on each side of the track

size-icon-sm.comment: 16px — inline with body and control labels

width-dialog-md.comment: the default dialog — a paragraph or two plus actions

font-size-display.comment: hero only — fluid, sits above h1

font-size-h6.comment: meets body size — weight and family carry the distinction

surface-backdrop.comment: recessed mat — collapses to the deepest forest (no darker neutral; demo default)

text-on-scrim.comment: text and controls placed directly on the scrim rather than on a panel — a lightbox caption, a close button. It cannot be text.primary (which follows the mode and would vanish in light) or text.inverse (which follows it the other way and vanishes in dark): the scrim is deep in BOTH modes, so its foreground is fixed like it is.

borders-stroke-weight-thin.comment: 1px — soft pill / chip outline (Badge, Tabs indicator)

elevation-flat.comment: no shadow — pressed, and the resting default

elevation-button-lift.comment: buttons still do NOT move — button-lift (the transform) stays at rest. The shadow appears under a stationary button, which reads as it pressing outward rather than sliding, and gives the hover a second cue beyond the lightness bump.

status-success-subtle.comment: the tint end goes deep in dark, like the accent tints

status-danger-fill.comment: hazard yellow, deepened for dark — carries a black label at 9.93:1

status-danger-on-fill.comment: black on the tape, the same pair as light

status-danger-text.comment: danger AS TEXT — the palest red, and the same lift brand-as-text takes. It has to be the palest one: red.300 fails on Confetti's `card` (3.50:1) and on Adventure's #35492f and Neon's #2e1650 too, so no theme on this mode can afford the more saturated step.

status-danger-stripe.comment: the hazard stripe on a danger control — full black on yellow, so the diagonal reads as tape rather than as texture

brand-primary.comment: pine green — reads as text on sand (4.7:1) and as button fill with white (6.5:1)

badge-border-width.comment: soft pill — 1px hairline, not the 2px sticker edge

badge-border.comment: soft pill — subtle tint, not the ink sticker border

badge-fill-neutral.comment: paper fill — a badge that isn't a category

button-danger-stripe-width.comment: 8px band, so the diagonal repeats every 16px

button-danger-stripe-duration.comment: one full pass of the pattern

button-danger-label-pad-x.comment: 8px — one stripe-width of clear colour either side of the label

button-danger-label-pad-y.comment: 4px — enough that a diagonal never clips an ascender or a descender

code-muted.comment: comments and punctuation — present but receding

code-inline-padding-horizontal.comment: 4px — snug, so the chip does not disturb the line

code-inline-padding-vertical.comment: 0 — vertical padding on an inline box shifts line height without growing the line

code-font-family.comment: the mono face — same one Badge and Tabs label with

modal-shadow.comment: the sticker lift, held at rest — a dialog is already raised

overlay-scrim-fill.comment: the dim itself — the one consumer of the axis-independent --color-scrim role, fixed across themes and modes

overlay-text.comment: set on the scrim so anything placed straight onto it inherits a legible colour. Content that brings its own surface (Modal's panel) overrides this with its own foreground.

overlay-viewport-padding.comment: 24px — keeps the content off the viewport edge on small screens

slider-height.comment: 48px — the hit area, not the rail

slider-fill-fill.comment: the travelled portion — brand, so progress reads at a glance

slider-thumb-shadow.comment: the sticker lift, held at rest — the knob sits above the rail

slider-gap.comment: 8px between the rail and an adjacent label or value

switch-border-width.comment: the sticker edge — a switch is a control, so it carries the same outline as a button

switch-thumb-fill.comment: ink knob on the paper track

switch-thumb-fill-checked.comment: and the inverse on the brand track

switch-icon-color.comment: the glyph sits ON the thumb, so it takes the track's fill

switch-gap.comment: 8px between the switch and an adjacent label

tabs-track-radius.comment: matches the pill — the rail is a control, not a container, so it takes the same radius the indicator does (999px round in Confetti, 12px in Adventure, square in Neon)

tabs-hover-text.comment: an idle tab warms to full-strength text on hover, short of the lit pill

tabs-font-size.comment: 14px mono — the control label, sized for legibility

tabs-tab-padding-horizontal.comment: 20px — roomy, so the control reads at a comfortable tap size

toast-border-width.comment: the 2px sticker edge — same as Card

toast-shadow.comment: the hard offset — a toast sits above the page, and this is how this system says so

toast-min-width.comment: matches the small dialog, so a toast and a confirmation read as the same family

slider-thumb-shadow.comment: the sticker lift, held at rest — the knob sits above the rail

slider-gap.comment: 8px between the rail and an adjacent label or value

switch-border-width.comment: the sticker edge — a switch is a control, so it carries the same outline as a button

switch-thumb-fill.comment: ink knob on the paper track

switch-thumb-fill-checked.comment: and the inverse on the brand track

switch-icon-color.comment: the glyph sits ON the thumb, so it takes the track's fill

switch-gap.comment: 8px between the switch and an adjacent label

tabs-track-radius.comment: matches the pill — the rail is a control, not a container, so it takes the same radius the indicator does (999px round in Confetti, 12px in Adventure, square in Neon)

tabs-hover-text.comment: an idle tab warms to full-strength text on hover, short of the lit pill

tabs-font-size.comment: 14px mono — the control label, sized for legibility

tabs-tab-padding-horizontal.comment: 20px — roomy, so the control reads at a comfortable tap size

toast-border-width.comment: the 2px sticker edge — same as Card

toast-shadow.comment: the hard offset — a toast sits above the page, and this is how this system says so

toast-min-width.comment: matches the small dialog, so a toast and a confirmation read as the same family

colors-cream-a16.comment: cream at 16% — the dark-mode counterpart to ink.a12

colors-ink-600.comment: canonical Ink — warm near-black, text and borders

colors-ink-a86.comment: ink 900 at 86% — the modal / lightbox scrim (deeper base than the a12/a18/a24 borders)

colors-graphite-400.comment: card — the lightest dark surface, so it sets the contrast floor for everything that sits on dark. Held here because it is the lightest value at which red.200, chalk.400 and green.400 all still clear AA; a step lighter and the brand red has no usable value left.

colors-graphite-800.comment: page background baseline — the content ground. Not black: black sits below it as `backdrop`, which is what gives that role its meaning back.

colors-graphite-900.comment: backdrop — the recessed mat below page, and now genuinely below it. True black.

colors-graphite-a16.comment: chalk at 16% — subtle border on graphite

colors-chalk-100.comment: primary text and borders on graphite

colors-chalk-400.comment: muted text on graphite — clears AA on `card`, the lightest of them (5.16:1). Tied to how light `card` is: it had to go this pale once the surfaces came up.

colors-red-200.comment: confetti brand Red, lifted furthest — the palest step, and the ONLY one that reads AS TEXT on every dark surface including `card` (4.96:1). This is also the ceiling that fixes how light `card` can go: there is nothing paler to fall back on.

colors-red-300.comment: confetti brand Red, lifted — reads on the darker surfaces but not on card (3.50:1). Only usable as the dark accent when `card` is close to black, which it no longer is.

colors-red-600.comment: deepened Red — kept as the danger family's dark step. No longer the hazard stripe: that pair moved to yellow/black (see the yellow family below).

colors-yellow-500.comment: hazard yellow on a light page — carries black at 12.88:1, and the black stripes read as stripes rather than texture

colors-yellow-600.comment: the deeper step, for DARK mode where the 500 glares against a near-black page. Still carries black at 9.93:1.

colors-green-100.comment: pale tint — the subtle end of the pair in LIGHT mode, carrying green.700 (5.25:1)

colors-green-400.comment: success AS TEXT on a dark surface — lifted enough to clear AA on card, the lightest dark surface (5.5:1)

colors-green-600.comment: the rich green — success as a FILL, carrying a white label (5.34:1). Same in both modes; a fill does not need to move.

colors-green-700.comment: success AS TEXT on a light surface (4.86:1 on cream)

colors-green-800.comment: deep tint — the subtle end of the pair in DARK mode, carrying chalk (10.37:1)

colors-pine-300.comment: brand, lifted enough to read AS TEXT on the forest dark surface

colors-pine-500.comment: Adventure brand green — reads as text on sand (4.8:1) and as button fill w/ white (6.6:1)

colors-sand-a12.comment: bark at 12% — subtle border on sand

colors-bark-600.comment: warm near-black — Adventure light-mode text and borders

colors-forest-a16.comment: sand at 16% — subtle border on forest

colors-neon-pink-600.comment: deep magenta — brand AS TEXT on light

colors-grape-900.comment: neon light text / border — deep purple

colors-glow-100.comment: neon dark text / border — light lavender

colors-stone-400.comment: recessed mat — a step below page

colors-stone-600.comment: muted text — 5.05:1 on page, 5.28:1 on raised, 4.66:1 on panel

font-size-400.comment: utility step — off the 4px grid (like 14), for body-large / small subheads

font-size-600.comment: utility step — off the 4px grid, sits between h5 (20) and h4 (24)

font-size-hero.comment: container-query driven headline, above the fixed ramp

shadow-hard-ink.comment: hard offset shadow — the sticker lift, no blur

shadow-hard-cream.comment: dark-mode counterpart — light offset against dark surfaces

shadow-soft.comment: diffuse ambient shadow on light surfaces — rests just above the page

shadow-lifted.comment: soft, deeper — hover and floating surfaces on light

shadow-soft-deep.comment: dark-surface counterpart of soft — black, since a light shadow does not read on dark

effect-brightness-lighten-strong.comment: 22% brighter — the bump a theme needs when brightness is carrying the whole hover, with no lift to help. 1.1 reads on a pale fill and all but vanishes on a deep one, which is what left Adventure's pine buttons looking inert.

effect-brightness-rest.comment: 1 — no lightness change, the pressed counterpart to a theme's hover brightness

effect-button-hover-brightness.comment: hover lightness multiplier for buttons that change lightness instead of lifting

motion-tilt-subtle.comment: outer bound of the hand-placed sticker tilt — components scale this by a per-instance multiplier in -1..1

motion-tilt-none.comment: no tilt — cards stay square on hover

motion-lift-soft.comment: a quiet rise with no sideways travel — the premium counterpart of lift

motion-duration-ambient.comment: one loop of a continuous, non-reactive animation — a texture that drifts rather than a state that changes

motion-easing-ambient.comment: constant speed, so a looping animation has no perceptible seam

motion-button-lift.comment: the hover transform on filled buttons — a lift, or rest (no move), per theme

duration-300.comment: one loop of a continuous ambient motion — slow enough to read as texture moving, not as a control reacting

easing-linear.comment: the only correct curve for a seamless loop — any easing makes a continuous animation pulse at the seam

size-switch-thumb.comment: 20px — leaves a 2px inset on each side of the track

size-icon-sm.comment: 16px — inline with body and control labels

width-dialog-md.comment: the default dialog — a paragraph or two plus actions

font-size-display.comment: hero only — fluid, sits above h1

font-size-h6.comment: meets body size — weight and family carry the distinction

surface-backdrop.comment: recessed mat behind the app frame / control tracks — a step below page

text-on-scrim.comment: text and controls placed directly on the scrim rather than on a panel — a lightbox caption, a close button. It cannot be text.primary (which follows the mode and would vanish in light) or text.inverse (which follows it the other way and vanishes in dark): the scrim is deep in BOTH modes, so its foreground is fixed like it is.

borders-stroke-weight-thin.comment: 1px — soft pill / chip outline (Badge, Tabs indicator)

elevation-flat.comment: no shadow — pressed, and the resting default

elevation-button-lift.comment: button hover shadow — separate from card so a theme can drop it (flat) or swap it (glow)

accent-on-bold.comment: ink reads on the light bold hues

accent-on-subtle.comment: ink reads on the pale subtle tints

status-success-subtle.comment: the tint end of the pair — Badge subtle, Toast

status-danger-fill.comment: hazard yellow ground, carrying a black label at 12.88:1

status-danger-on-fill.comment: black on the tape — the other half of the caution pair

status-danger-text.comment: danger AS TEXT — 4.97:1 on the page, 6.27:1 on card

status-danger-stripe.comment: the hazard stripe on a danger control — full black on yellow, so the diagonal reads as tape rather than as texture

brand-primary.comment: brand color — drives text.accent, primary action fill, ghost hover

syntax-surface.comment: deepest ink — the code block ground

badge-border-width.comment: soft pill — 1px hairline, not the 2px sticker edge

badge-border.comment: soft pill — subtle tint, not the ink sticker border

badge-fill-neutral.comment: paper fill — a badge that isn't a category

button-danger-stripe-width.comment: 8px band, so the diagonal repeats every 16px

button-danger-stripe-duration.comment: one full pass of the pattern

button-danger-label-pad-x.comment: 8px — one stripe-width of clear colour either side of the label

button-danger-label-pad-y.comment: 4px — enough that a diagonal never clips an ascender or a descender

status-danger-stripe.comment: the hazard stripe on a danger control — full black on yellow, so the diagonal reads as tape rather than as texture

brand-primary.comment: bright magenta — fill (with black label, 6:1) and text.accent on dark

brand-on-primary.comment: black label on the neon fill — 80s style, and the only thing that passes on bright magenta

badge-border-width.comment: soft pill — 1px hairline, not the 2px sticker edge

badge-border.comment: soft pill — subtle tint, not the ink sticker border

badge-fill-neutral.comment: paper fill — a badge that isn't a category

button-danger-stripe-width.comment: 8px band, so the diagonal repeats every 16px

button-danger-stripe-duration.comment: one full pass of the pattern

button-danger-label-pad-x.comment: 8px — one stripe-width of clear colour either side of the label

button-danger-label-pad-y.comment: 4px — enough that a diagonal never clips an ascender or a descender

code-muted.comment: comments and punctuation — present but receding

code-inline-padding-horizontal.comment: 4px — snug, so the chip does not disturb the line

code-inline-padding-vertical.comment: 0 — vertical padding on an inline box shifts line height without growing the line

code-font-family.comment: the mono face — same one Badge and Tabs label with

modal-shadow.comment: the sticker lift, held at rest — a dialog is already raised

overlay-scrim-fill.comment: the dim itself — the one consumer of the axis-independent --color-scrim role, fixed across themes and modes

overlay-text.comment: set on the scrim so anything placed straight onto it inherits a legible colour. Content that brings its own surface (Modal's panel) overrides this with its own foreground.

overlay-viewport-padding.comment: 24px — keeps the content off the viewport edge on small screens

slider-height.comment: 48px — the hit area, not the rail

slider-fill-fill.comment: the travelled portion — brand, so progress reads at a glance

slider-thumb-shadow.comment: the sticker lift, held at rest — the knob sits above the rail

slider-gap.comment: 8px between the rail and an adjacent label or value

switch-border-width.comment: the sticker edge — a switch is a control, so it carries the same outline as a button

switch-thumb-fill.comment: ink knob on the paper track

switch-thumb-fill-checked.comment: and the inverse on the brand track

switch-icon-color.comment: the glyph sits ON the thumb, so it takes the track's fill

switch-gap.comment: 8px between the switch and an adjacent label

tabs-track-radius.comment: matches the pill — the rail is a control, not a container, so it takes the same radius the indicator does (999px round in Confetti, 12px in Adventure, square in Neon)

tabs-hover-text.comment: an idle tab warms to full-strength text on hover, short of the lit pill

tabs-font-size.comment: 14px mono — the control label, sized for legibility

tabs-tab-padding-horizontal.comment: 20px — roomy, so the control reads at a comfortable tap size

toast-border-width.comment: the 2px sticker edge — same as Card

toast-shadow.comment: the hard offset — a toast sits above the page, and this is how this system says so

toast-min-width.comment: matches the small dialog, so a toast and a confirmation read as the same family
